label: Senior deduction (Schedule 1-A Part V), dependent standard deduction, and Schedule 1-A Parts II-IV absence-declaration vocabulary

fact_types.title: Taxpayer assertion: the taxpayer has a social security number valid for employment, issued by the SSA before the due date of the 2025 return (including extensions) -- Schedule 1-A Part V, lines 36a/37 (Pub. L. 119-21 Sec. 70103, 26 USC 151(d)(5)(C)(iv)).

Taxpayer assertion: the spouse has a social security number valid for employment, issued by the SSA before the due date of the 2025 return (including extensions) -- Schedule 1-A Part V, lines 36b/37 (Pub. L. 119-21 Sec. 70103, 26 USC 151(d)(5)(C)(iv)).

Taxpayer assertion: someone else can claim the taxpayer, or the spouse on a joint return, as a dependent for 2025 -- governs the whole return's Form 1040 line 12e under the Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents. Defined for Track 2 of this milestone; not yet bound or required by any rule in this track.

Taxpayer assertion: the return claims no deduction for qualified tips, qualified overtime compensation or qualified passenger vehicle loan interest (Schedule 1-A Parts II-IV). Successor to tax.us.2025.schedule1a.no-additional-deductions-declared, narrowed to Parts II-IV now that Part V (the enhanced deduction for seniors) is computed separately.
